findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger instead of the receiver, so logs go somewhere the test cannot inspect
findings.description: `FromContext(_ context.Context) Logger` ignores its argument and returns `NewTestLogger()`, a new object with empty state. It does not return `f`, so any call made through the returned logger is recorded in a different `TestLogger` than the one the test holds. This matters because the diff changes `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` to call `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. If `LoggerMiddleware` is tested with a `TestLogger` and then checks `InfoLogs` or `Calls` on that instance, those assertions will see nothing. The fix is for `FromContext` to return `f` (or to share state with it). The diff alone does not show whether such a test exists, so this is a visible slip in the changed lines and the consequence is unverified.

findings.title: Test name still refers to the removed InstrumentationMiddleware
findings.description: The file was renamed to `metrics_middleware_test.go` and the constructor call was changed to `newMetricsMiddleware`, but the test function is still named `TestInstrumentationMiddleware`. The type it exercises is now `MetricsMiddleware`, and the `InstrumentationMiddleware` type no longer exists. The name no longer matches the code under test.
